senses.en: a person or thing added to something
senses.pattern: a new addition to the family / a welcome addition / the latest addition to the team
senses.example: The baby panda is the latest [[addition]] to the zoo, and visitors line up for hours to see it.
senses.example_zh: 這隻熊貓寶寶是動物園最新加入的成員，遊客排好幾個小時的隊就為了看牠。
senses.note: 常接 to：an addition to＋團體、收藏

gsat.sentence: The new [[addition]] to Morgan’s Wonderland.

senses.en: far along in age or at a late stage
senses.pattern: advanced age / advanced years / an advanced stage of cancer
senses.example: Despite her [[advanced]] age, my grandmother still walks to the market by herself every morning.
senses.example_zh: 儘管年邁，我的祖母仍然每天早上自己走路去市場。

senses.en: very much; to a great degree
senses.pattern: badly need / badly want / be badly in need of
senses.example: After three months without rain, the farmers [[badly]] need water for their rice fields.
senses.example_zh: 三個月沒下雨，農民迫切地需要水來灌溉稻田。
senses.note: 此義多與 need、want 連用

senses.en: seriously or severely
senses.pattern: badly injured / badly damaged / badly hurt / badly affected
senses.example: The old bridge was so [[badly]] damaged by the flood that it had to be closed.
senses.example_zh: 那座老橋被洪水嚴重地損壞，不得不封閉。

gsat.sentence: Becky twisted her ankle while she was playing tennis last week. Now it still hurts [[badly]].
[[Badly]] injured in the car accident, Jason could scarcely move his legs and was sent to the hospital right away.

senses.en: the money left in an account or still owed
senses.pattern: bank balance / check your balance / pay the balance
senses.example: Before buying the concert tickets online, Amy checked the [[balance]] in her bank account.
senses.example_zh: 上網買演唱會門票前，艾咪先查了銀行帳戶的餘額。

senses.en: to compare the importance of two different things
senses.pattern: balance A against B / balance the benefits against the risks / balance costs and benefits
senses.example: Doctors must [[balance]] the benefits of a new drug against its possible side effects.
senses.example_zh: 醫生必須權衡新藥的療效與可能產生的副作用。

senses.en: a written proposal for a new law
senses.pattern: pass a bill / propose a bill / vote on a bill / a bill on education
senses.example: After a long debate, the parliament finally passed a [[bill]] banning plastic straws in restaurants.
senses.example_zh: 經過漫長的辯論，國會終於通過一項禁止餐廳使用塑膠吸管的法案。

senses.en: to advertise or describe someone or something as
senses.pattern: be billed as / bill itself as / bill sb as
senses.example: The concert was [[billed]] as the biggest music event of the summer, but few people came.
senses.example_zh: 那場演唱會被宣傳為今夏最盛大的音樂活動，結果卻沒什麼人來。
senses.note: 常用 bill A as B

gsat.sentence: Founded in 1992, with some 28,000 listings, this company [[bills]] itself as the world’s largest home exchange club, reporting that membership has increased 30% this year.

senses.en: showing no feeling, understanding, or interest
senses.pattern: a blank look / a blank expression / a blank stare / go blank
senses.example: When the teacher asked about the homework, Leo just gave her a [[blank]] look and said nothing.
senses.example_zh: 老師問起作業時，里歐只是一臉茫然地看著她，什麼也沒說。
senses.note: go blank 指腦中一片空白

senses.en: a group of people who control an organization
senses.pattern: board of directors / school board / sit on the board / a board meeting
senses.example: The hospital's [[board]] of directors approved a plan to build a new children's wing next year.
senses.example_zh: 醫院董事會通過了明年興建新兒童病房大樓的計畫。

senses.en: to get on a ship, plane, train, or bus
senses.pattern: board a plane / board the train / board a ship
senses.example: Passengers are requested to [[board]] the ferry at least ten minutes before it departs.
senses.example_zh: 乘客請於啟航前至少十分鐘登上渡輪。

gsat.sentence: There were so many people at the bus station that I had to elbow my way through the crowd to [[board]] the bus in time.
From Turkey, she [[boarded]] a small boat that held 20 people and set sail into the deep waters of the Aegean Sea.

senses.en: a letter, number, or symbol used in writing or computing
senses.pattern: Chinese characters / a password of eight characters / special characters
senses.example: Your password must contain at least eight [[characters]], including one number and one capital letter.
senses.example_zh: 你的密碼必須至少包含八個字元，其中要有一個數字和一個大寫字母。

senses.en: strong moral qualities such as honesty and courage
senses.pattern: build character / a person of character / strength of character
senses.example: Our principal believes that doing volunteer work builds [[character]] far better than any lecture can.
senses.example_zh: 我們校長認為，做志工比任何說教更能培養品格。

senses.en: to accuse someone formally of a crime
senses.pattern: charge sb with theft / be charged with murder / charge sb with a crime
senses.example: Police [[charged]] the driver with causing the accident after checking the street cameras.
senses.example_zh: 警方查看路口監視器後，控告該名駕駛肇事。
senses.note: 名詞 charge 也指「罪名、指控」

senses.en: to rush forward, especially to attack
senses.pattern: charge at / charge toward / charge into the room
senses.example: The angry bull lowered its head and [[charged]] at the farmer, who jumped over the fence.
senses.example_zh: 憤怒的公牛低下頭，朝農夫猛衝過去，農夫趕緊跳過籬笆。

gsat.sentence: Then they wanted to put him in jail and [[charged]] him with violation of law for climbing the building without a permit.

senses.en: total; used to emphasize how great something is
senses.pattern: a complete stranger / a complete surprise / a complete disaster / a complete waste of time
senses.example: The school play was a [[complete]] disaster because half of the actors forgot their lines.
senses.example_zh: 這齣校園話劇是一場徹底的災難，因為半數演員都忘了台詞。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前，用來加強語氣

senses.en: to write the information needed on a form
senses.pattern: complete a form / complete a questionnaire / complete an application
senses.example: Please [[complete]] the application form in black ink and return it to the office by Friday.
senses.example_zh: 請用黑筆填寫申請表，並於週五前交回辦公室。

senses.en: to tell or show someone the way
senses.pattern: direct somebody to the station / direct visitors to the exit / direct ships into port
senses.example: A kind shop owner [[directed]] the lost tourists to the nearest subway station.
senses.example_zh: 一位好心的店老闆為迷路的觀光客指路，告訴他們最近的捷運站怎麼走。

senses.en: to aim something at a particular person or thing
senses.pattern: direct criticism at / direct attention to / be directed at
senses.example: Most of the criticism was [[directed]] at the manager rather than at the players.
senses.example_zh: 大部分的批評是針對經理，而不是球員。

gsat.sentence: The pilot is needed to [[direct]] large ships into a port, where there are often deep water channels surrounded by shallower seabeds.

senses.en: the person in charge of an organization or department
senses.pattern: the director of the museum / a program director / the director of marketing / a medical director
senses.example: The [[director]] of the city library announced longer opening hours during the exam season.
senses.example_zh: 市立圖書館館長宣布，考試期間將延長開放時間。

senses.en: a member of the board that runs a company
senses.pattern: the board of directors / a managing director / a company director
senses.example: The board of [[directors]] voted to close two factories and move production overseas.
senses.example_zh: 董事會投票決定關閉兩座工廠，並將生產移往海外。

gsat.sentence: “They must remain here if the museum is to continue to achieve its aim, which is to show the world to the world,” said the [[director]] of the museum.

senses.en: relating to the home or family life
senses.pattern: domestic chores / domestic appliances / domestic violence
senses.example: In many families, [[domestic]] chores such as cooking and laundry are now shared by both parents.
senses.example_zh: 在許多家庭裡，煮飯、洗衣等家務現在由父母雙方分擔。

senses.en: (of animals) kept on farms or as pets
senses.pattern: domestic animals / domestic cats / domestic and wild animals
senses.example: Unlike wolves, [[domestic]] dogs have learned to read human gestures and facial expressions.
senses.example_zh: 與狼不同，人類馴養的狗已學會解讀人的手勢和臉部表情。

senses.en: a small amount of a quality or feeling
senses.pattern: an element of truth / an element of risk / an element of surprise / an element of luck
senses.example: There is always an [[element]] of risk in starting a business, however carefully you plan.
senses.example_zh: 無論計畫得多仔細，創業總是帶有些許風險。
senses.note: be in one's element 如魚得水

senses.en: the weather, especially wind, rain, and cold
senses.pattern: be exposed to the elements / brave the elements / shelter from the elements
senses.example: The hikers built a simple shelter of branches to protect themselves from the [[elements]] overnight.
senses.example_zh: 登山客用樹枝搭了一個簡單的遮蔽處，好在夜裡抵擋風雨。

senses.en: to include as an important part or performer
senses.pattern: feature live music / a film featuring / be featured in / feature sb as
senses.example: This year's science fair will [[feature]] robots designed and built entirely by high school students.
senses.example_zh: 今年的科展將以完全由高中生設計製作的機器人為特色。

senses.en: a special article or program about a subject
senses.pattern: a feature on / a feature article / a feature story / a special feature
senses.example: The magazine ran a ten-page [[feature]] on young farmers who returned to their hometowns.
senses.example_zh: 這本雜誌刊登了一篇十頁的專題報導，介紹返鄉的青年農民。

senses.en: a part of the face, such as the eyes or nose
senses.pattern: facial features / delicate features / sharp features / handsome features
senses.example: The baby has her mother's delicate [[features]], including the same small nose and bright eyes.
senses.example_zh: 這個寶寶遺傳了媽媽細緻的五官，同樣有小巧的鼻子和明亮的眼睛。

gsat.sentence: Open since 1996, the store [[features]] traditional-style home accessories, ranging from cabinets and chairs to picture frames and decorative mirrors.
Typically [[featuring]] zombies and serial killers, horror movies are too frightening to be fun for some people.

senses.en: to make something grow or become stronger
senses.pattern: fuel fears / fuel speculation / fuel demand / fuel the growth of
senses.example: Rumors on social media [[fueled]] fears that the factory would close before the end of the year.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體上的謠言助長了恐懼，大家擔心工廠會在年底前關閉。
senses.note: 英式拼法過去式為 fuelled

gsat.sentence: And Africa [[fueled]] another interest in him: photography.
Each year, tens of millions of animals, including dogs and cats, needlessly suffer and die to [[fuel]] the fur industry.

senses.en: to cope with a difficult situation, especially with little money
senses.pattern: manage on sth / manage without sth / manage on one's own
senses.example: After her father lost his job, the family had to [[manage]] on a much smaller income.
senses.example_zh: 她父親失業後，全家只好靠少得多的收入勉強度日。

senses.zh: 勉強做到；擠出（笑容、時間）
senses.en: to succeed in producing or doing something difficult
senses.pattern: manage a smile / manage a few words / can't manage Friday
senses.example: Although she was deeply disappointed with the result, the runner [[managed]] a smile for the cameras.
senses.example_zh: 儘管對結果非常失望，這位跑者仍對著鏡頭勉強擠出一個微笑。
senses.note: manage to V＝設法做到（熟義）

gsat.sentence: All the obstacles of reality can be set aside and you are able to accomplish tasks that you could never [[manage]] in waking reality.

senses.en: a person who is not yet legally an adult
senses.pattern: sell alcohol to minors / protect minors / be still a minor
senses.example: It is against the law for stores to sell cigarettes or alcohol to [[minors]].
senses.example_zh: 商店販售香菸或酒類給未成年人是違法的。

senses.en: a second subject studied at college besides the main one
senses.pattern: a minor in music / choose a minor / with a minor in history
senses.example: She is majoring in biology with a [[minor]] in Japanese, hoping to do research in Kyoto someday.
senses.example_zh: 她主修生物，副修科目是日文，希望有朝一日能到京都做研究。
senses.note: 動詞用法：minor in… 副修…

senses.en: showing no sign of the disease or substance tested for
senses.pattern: test negative for / a negative result / come back negative
senses.example: Her flu test came back [[negative]], so the doctor said she could return to school.
senses.example_zh: 她的流感檢驗結果呈陰性，所以醫生說她可以回學校上課。

senses.en: a piece of film from which photographs are printed
senses.pattern: a photographic negative / film negatives / print from a negative
senses.example: My grandfather still keeps the [[negatives]] of his wedding photos in a small metal box.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺仍把結婚照的底片保存在一個小鐵盒裡。

gsat.sentence: Even when tests came back [[negative]], more were ordered, and she was hospitalized as a precaution when she developed a cold.

senses.en: to express something in particular words
senses.pattern: phrase a question / carefully phrased / phrase it differently / politely phrased
senses.example: She [[phrased]] her criticism so gently that nobody in the meeting felt offended.
senses.example_zh: 她把批評表達得非常委婉，會議上沒有人覺得被冒犯。

senses.en: with nothing added, or without pattern or decoration
senses.pattern: plain water / plain yogurt / plain rice / a plain white shirt
senses.example: I prefer [[plain]] yogurt with fresh fruit to the sweetened kind sold in most supermarkets.
senses.example_zh: 比起多數超市賣的加糖優格，我比較喜歡原味優格配新鮮水果。

senses.en: easy to see or understand; clear
senses.pattern: make it plain that / in plain English / plain to see / the plain truth
senses.example: The teacher made it [[plain]] that late homework would no longer be accepted for any reason.
senses.example_zh: 老師明白表示，無論任何理由都不再收遲交的作業。
senses.note: 副詞 plainly 清楚地；顯然

gsat.sentence: Replacing lost fluid with just [[plain]] water means the body has too much water and not enough salt.

The team has also developed a special device which uses scent bottles and visual trickery to make the wearers of these glasses think that the [[plain]] snack they are eating is tastier than it actually is.

senses.en: to hit something hard again and again
senses.pattern: pound the table / pound the door with one's fists / waves pound the coast
senses.example: Huge waves [[pounded]] the sea wall all night, flooding the road behind it by morning.
senses.example_zh: 巨浪整夜猛擊海堤，到了早上後方的道路已經淹水。

senses.en: (of the heart) to beat very fast and hard
senses.pattern: sb's heart pounds / with a pounding heart / pound with fear
senses.example: My heart was [[pounding]] as I walked onto the stage to give my first speech.
senses.example_zh: 我走上台發表第一次演講時，心臟怦怦跳個不停。

senses.en: the head of a company, club, or organization
senses.pattern: company president / vice president / club president / president of the student council
senses.example: The [[president]] of the software company announced plans to open three new offices in Asia.
senses.example_zh: 這家軟體公司的總裁宣布了在亞洲開設三間新辦公室的計畫。

senses.en: the head of a college or university
senses.pattern: university president / college president / president of the university
senses.example: The university [[president]] handed each graduate a diploma and shook hands with their parents.
senses.example_zh: 大學校長把畢業證書頒給每位畢業生，並與他們的家長握手。

gsat.sentence: He is the executive vice [[president]] of the HSUS.

senses.en: a characteristic or feature of a person or thing
senses.pattern: leadership qualities / personal qualities / have the qualities of
senses.example: Patience is the most important [[quality]] a kindergarten teacher can have, according to the school's principal.
senses.example_zh: 根據該校校長的說法，耐心是幼兒園老師所能具備最重要的特質。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞，常用複數

gsat.sentence: Girls’ names such as Faith, Patience, and Sophie (wisdom) are chosen because they symbolize Christian [[qualities]].
This fire resistant [[quality]] explains why the giant redwood grows to live that long.

senses.en: (of meat) cooked briefly so the inside is still red
senses.pattern: a rare steak / medium rare / cooked rare
senses.example: I asked for my steak well done, but the waiter brought one that was [[rare]].
senses.example_zh: 我點的牛排要全熟，服務生卻端來一份一分熟的。
senses.note: medium rare 三分熟；well done 全熟

senses.en: to achieve something you hoped or planned for
senses.pattern: realize a dream / realize one's ambition / realize one's potential / realize a goal
senses.example: With a scholarship from the city, Nora finally [[realized]] her ambition of studying music abroad.
senses.example_zh: 靠著市政府的獎學金，諾拉終於實現了出國學音樂的抱負。
senses.note: 名詞 realization 亦有「實現」之意

gsat.sentence: After years of hard work, Kareem has not only [[realized]] his dream but also transformed a piece of deserted property into a beautiful forest.
We work very hard to [[realize]] this dream.

senses.en: respect or admiration for someone or something
senses.pattern: have a high regard for / hold sb in high regard / be held in high regard
senses.example: The students have a high [[regard]] for their coach, who always treats every player fairly.
senses.example_zh: 學生們非常尊重他們的教練，因為他總是公平對待每位球員。

senses.en: attention to or thought for something
senses.pattern: without regard for / have no regard for / show little regard for
senses.example: Some drivers race through the village with no [[regard]] for the safety of children.
senses.example_zh: 有些駕駛高速駛過村莊，完全不顧及孩童的安全。

senses.en: good wishes sent to someone
senses.pattern: give my regards to / send one's regards / best regards / warm regards
senses.example: Please give my warmest [[regards]] to your grandparents when you visit them this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 你這個週末去探望祖父母時，請代我向他們致上最誠摯的問候。

senses.en: food, money, or help given to people in need
senses.pattern: disaster relief / relief supplies / relief workers / flood relief
senses.example: Trucks loaded with [[relief]] supplies reached the mountain village three days after the landslide.
senses.example_zh: 滿載救濟物資的卡車在山崩發生三天後抵達那座山村。

senses.en: a design that stands out from a flat surface
senses.pattern: a stone relief / carved in relief / a relief sculpture
senses.example: The temple walls are covered with stone [[reliefs]] showing scenes from ancient legends.
senses.example_zh: 廟宇的牆上布滿石刻浮雕，呈現古代傳說中的場景。

senses.en: profit made from an investment
senses.pattern: a return on investment / a high return / a good return / returns on savings
senses.example: Investors were promised a ten percent [[return]] within a year, which turned out to be a lie.
senses.example_zh: 投資人被承諾一年內有百分之十的收益，結果竟是一場謊言。

senses.en: to do or give something similar in response
senses.pattern: return a favor / return sb's call / return a smile / return the compliment
senses.example: You helped me move last month, so let me [[return]] the favor by fixing your bike.
senses.example_zh: 你上個月幫我搬家，所以讓我幫你修腳踏車來回報你。

senses.en: not exact or detailed; approximate
senses.pattern: a rough idea / a rough estimate / a rough draft / a rough guess
senses.example: This is only a [[rough]] draft, so please ignore the spelling mistakes for now.
senses.example_zh: 這只是一份粗略的草稿，所以請先別管拼字錯誤。

senses.en: difficult and unpleasant
senses.pattern: a rough day / have a rough time / a rough start / go through a rough patch
senses.example: She had a [[rough]] first year abroad, struggling with the language and missing her family.
senses.example_zh: 她在國外的第一年很艱難，既要克服語言障礙，又想念家人。

senses.en: (of the sea or weather) wild and stormy
senses.pattern: rough seas / rough weather / a rough crossing
senses.example: The ferry was canceled because the sea was too [[rough]] for a safe crossing.
senses.example_zh: 渡輪停駛了，因為海上風浪太大，無法安全橫渡。

senses.en: a photograph, or a single scene in a film
senses.pattern: take a shot of / get a good shot / a close-up shot
senses.example: The photographer waited two hours by the lake to get a perfect [[shot]] of the sunrise.
senses.example_zh: 那位攝影師在湖邊等了兩個小時，才拍到一張完美的日出照片。

senses.en: an injection of a medicine or vaccine
senses.pattern: a flu shot / get a shot / give sb a shot
senses.example: The nurse told the little girl that the [[shot]] would hurt only for a second.
senses.example_zh: 護理師告訴小女孩，打針只會痛一下下。

senses.en: an attempt to do or achieve something
senses.pattern: give it a shot / have a shot at / take a shot at
senses.example: I had never tried rock climbing before, but I decided to give it a [[shot]].
senses.example_zh: 我以前從沒試過攀岩，但我決定嘗試看看。

gsat.sentence: You may have to wait for a while until the animal does something interesting or moves into a position for you to get a good [[shot]].
Getting a flu [[shot]] before the start of flu season gives our body a chance to build up protection against the virus that could make us sick.

senses.en: a person or document that provides information
senses.pattern: a reliable source / according to sources / an anonymous source / protect one's sources
senses.example: The reporter refused to name her [[sources]], saying they might lose their jobs if identified.
senses.example_zh: 這名記者拒絕透露她的消息來源，表示他們若被認出可能會丟掉工作。

senses.en: to get materials or products from a particular place
senses.pattern: source materials locally / be sourced from / source ingredients from farms
senses.example: The café [[sources]] its vegetables from small farms within thirty kilometers of the city.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館的蔬菜採購自市區方圓三十公里內的小農場。

gsat.sentence: This information came from a very reliable [[source]], so you don’t have to worry about being cheated.

senses.en: one of a series of actions to achieve something
senses.pattern: take steps to / a first step toward / a step in the right direction / the next step
senses.example: The hospital has taken [[steps]] to shorten waiting times in its emergency room.
senses.example_zh: 該醫院已採取措施，縮短急診室的候診時間。
senses.note: step in 介入；step down 下台

gsat.sentence: By providing [[steps]] for settling a disagreement.
These methods range from a simple [[step]] like makeup to a drastic one like surgery.

senses.en: to keep following a plan, rule, or promise
senses.pattern: stick to a plan / stick to the rules / stick to a budget / stick to one's promise
senses.example: If you [[stick]] to your study plan for a month, your grades will surely improve.
senses.example_zh: 只要你堅持照著讀書計畫做一個月，成績一定會進步。
senses.note: 此義須接 to；三態 stick–stuck–stuck

senses.en: to push a pointed object into something
senses.pattern: stick a needle into sth / stick a fork in sth / stick a pin in sth
senses.example: Be careful not to [[stick]] the needle into your finger while you are sewing on the button.
senses.example_zh: 縫鈕扣的時候要小心，別把針刺入手指。

gsat.sentence: To [[stick]] to a tight budget, Robert bought a more affordable LED TV instead of a fancy, expensive 3D TV.
Being vegan means I try to [[stick]] to plant food.

senses.en: excitement, interest, or shock felt by many people
senses.pattern: cause a stir / create a stir / quite a stir
senses.example: The discovery of a rare white deer created a [[stir]] in the quiet mountain town.
senses.example_zh: 發現一頭罕見白鹿的消息在這個寧靜的山城引起轟動。

senses.en: to make someone feel a strong emotion
senses.pattern: stir memories / stir the imagination / stir up anger / be deeply stirred
senses.example: The old photographs [[stirred]] memories of the summers we spent on our grandmother's farm.
senses.example_zh: 這些老照片激起了我們對外婆農場那些夏日時光的回憶。

senses.en: to accept or bear something unpleasant
senses.pattern: cannot stomach / hard to stomach / stomach the idea of
senses.example: Rita found it hard to [[stomach]] the rude way the customer spoke to the young waiter.
senses.example_zh: 麗塔覺得很難忍受那位顧客對年輕服務生說話的無禮態度。
senses.note: 多用於否定句或疑問句

senses.en: used to ask what would happen if
senses.pattern: Suppose (that) ... / Suppose you were ... / supposing (that) ...
senses.example: [[Suppose]] you lost your phone on a trip—how would you contact your family?
senses.example_zh: 假使你在旅途中弄丟了手機，你要怎麼聯絡家人？

senses.en: to be much taller or better than others
senses.pattern: tower over / tower above / tower over one's classmates
senses.example: Ancient redwood trees [[tower]] over the visitors walking along the forest trail.
senses.example_zh: 古老的紅杉高聳於森林步道上的遊客頭頂。

senses.en: a test to see if something works well
senses.pattern: a clinical trial / a trial period / on trial / trial and error
senses.example: The new vaccine proved safe in a clinical [[trial]] involving three thousand volunteers.
senses.example_zh: 這款新疫苗在一項有三千名自願受試者參與的臨床試驗中證實是安全的。

senses.en: a difficult experience that tests your patience or strength
senses.pattern: the trials of life / trials and tribulations / a trial to somebody
senses.example: Looking after three noisy children all day was a real [[trial]] for the new babysitter.
senses.example_zh: 整天照顧三個吵鬧的孩子，對新來的保母是一大考驗。

gsat.sentence: If that works, human [[trials]] will be next on the agenda.

senses.en: to begin and continue a war or campaign
senses.pattern: wage war on / wage a campaign against / wage a battle
senses.example: The city government is [[waging]] a campaign against littering in parks and on beaches.
senses.example_zh: 市政府正發動一場運動，打擊在公園和海灘亂丟垃圾的行為。

quiz.stem: Having lost most of its volunteers last year, the animal shelter ______ needs people to help feed the dogs and clean the cages.
quiz.explain_zh: badly＝非常、迫切地。收容所失去多數志工，迫切需要人手幫忙。

quiz.stem: The ancient wall paintings, left open to the ______ for centuries, have lost most of their color to sun, wind, and rain.
quiz.explain_zh: element＝（複數）風雨。古壁畫數百年來任憑日曬風吹雨淋，色彩大多褪去。

quiz.stem: For decades, the island's farmers have been ______ a battle against wild pigs that dig up their sweet potato fields at night.
quiz.explain_zh: wage＝進行（戰爭、戰鬥）。島上農民數十年來一直與夜裡破壞地瓜田的野豬作戰。

quiz.stem: Standing nearly 500 meters tall, the new skyscraper ______ over every other building in the city and can be seen from miles away.
quiz.explain_zh: tower＝高聳、遠高於。新摩天大樓比市內其他建築都高出許多。

quiz.stem: The international ______ effort began within hours of the flood, bringing food, clean water, and medicine to thousands of homeless villagers.
quiz.explain_zh: relief＝救濟。洪水後數小時內國際救濟行動展開，送來食物、水和藥品。

quiz.stem: Although Mark enjoys most horror movies, he simply cannot ______ scenes in which animals get hurt and always looks away from the screen.
quiz.explain_zh: stomach＝忍受。馬克無法忍受動物受傷的畫面，總會把頭轉開。

quiz.stem: Because of the patient's ______ age and weak heart, the doctors decided that an operation would be too risky.
quiz.explain_zh: advanced＝年邁的。病人年事已高、心臟又弱，醫生認為開刀太冒險。

quiz.stem: The sudden rise in online shopping during the pandemic ______ the demand for delivery workers, and thousands of new positions were created.
quiz.explain_zh: fuel＝助長、刺激。網購暴增刺激了對外送人員的需求。

quiz.stem: The pop singer's sudden announcement that she would retire at the height of her career caused quite a ______ among fans around the world.
quiz.explain_zh: stir＝騷動、轟動。歌手在事業巔峰突然宣布退休，引起全球歌迷轟動。

quiz.stem: I don't need exact figures yet; just give me a ______ estimate of how many guests will attend the school anniversary party.
quiz.explain_zh: rough＝粗略的、大致的。不需確切數字，只要粗略估計出席人數。
